text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wins the Osaka Hai and the crowd is in awe of her stunning performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio are among those watching from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Kitasan Black is disappointed by her loss, she expresses her desire to race Satono Diamond again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, she's determined to win next time. The two promise to face off again at the spring Tenno Sho.
